newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Big gains by most stocks in busy Estonian trade.
newsitem.headline: Big gains by most stocks in busy Estonian trade.

text.p: Almost all stocks made significant gains in buoyant trade on the Estonian share market on Wednesday as banks published their results for February, dealers said.
The Tallinn stock exchange index gained 2.86 percent to close at yet another record high of 210.67 percent on a turnover of 69.9 million kroons on the official list.
"Most people were waiting for the February results and this is what pushed the trade along as well as an increase of small investor interest," said one trader.
Forekspank was most traded throughout the day to finish 1.55 kroons higher on 151.80 kroons on 24.3 million kroons turnover.
"Forekspank had good figures, only two million kroons down from January's exceptional results," one dealer said.
Forekspank earlier reported February earnings of 9.25 million kroons versus 10.7 million kroons in January.
Hansapank, which also reported February profits, turned over 20.4 million kroons to close 2.95 kroons up on 207.00 kroons.
Savings Bank finished 6.05 kroons up at 102.90 kroons on trade of 11 million kroons of shares. It reported February profits of 12.5 million kroons versus 13.5 million kroons.
Union Bank shares saw a turnover of 8.9 million kroons of shares to end trading on 46.45 kroons, 2.25 kroons stronger.
Among other stocks, Tallinna Pank was 0.25 kroons stronger, finishing at 62.75 kroons with 3.4 million kroons traded.
Tallinna Farma was up 1.50 kroons to end on 116.50 kroons with a trade of 1.8 million kroons of shares.
The over-the-counter market turned over seven million kroons of shares.
Rakvere meat plant was the most active with a turnover of 2.3 million kroons to close 0.60 kroons higher on 14.25 kroons.
